resources.string: Translates the text of other apps in place, including text that loads while you use them. Display-only, so app logic keeps seeing the original strings.
Optional fallback that reads on-screen text when an app cannot be hooked. Not required for the Xposed module.
%1$s is loading the module. Pick apps below and reboot or force-stop them to apply.
Enable HookTrans in LSPosed (or your Xposed manager), tick the apps you want, then reboot.
Translate every app in the LSPosed scope
When off, only the apps you pick below are translated.
Text apps draw themselves (tab bars, badges)
Reaches labels painted straight to the screen, which no other hook can see. Safe for app logic, but it runs on every frame, so turn it on for apps whose chrome stays untranslated.
Catches menus and notification text that the view hooks miss. Riskier: strings.xml can hold URLs and keys. Turn on per app if something stays untranslated.

Reads every image on screen and paints the translation over it. Your images are never modified — apps still see the original. The most expensive option here: recognition runs on avatars and icons too, and it shows on battery.
Keep the original visible under image text
Draws the translation just below the original line instead of covering it, so you can check what was actually read.
Translate everything loaded, not just what is on screen

Translates text as the app receives it, so comments and replies still below the fold are already done when you scroll to them. The app\'s own data is never altered. Uses more memory and translation volume.
Only translate multi-word text and never touch styled text. Fewer strings translated, lowest chance of upsetting an app.
Leave links and tappable text alone
Text carrying links is skipped, because span offsets point into the original string.
Selectable text cannot use the display-only path, so this replaces the real text and the app will see the translation. Copying yields the translation too.
Never translate views whose id contains
Writes detail to the Xposed log. Leave off unless diagnosing.
Saved. Force-stop a translated app for changes to take effect.
Engine process unreachable. Open the app once and retry.
Delete every stored translation? Text will be fetched again the next time it appears.
